local_artifact_rules: each installed package has a local install artifact under the package ecosystem install-validation root
each local install artifact records source manifest, installed manifest, source digest, manifest digest, lock manifest digest, and trust signature
each local install artifact carries a deterministic artifact digest recomputed by the install-distribution checker
generated reports are summary outputs only and cannot appear as release manifest inputs
claim_boundary: from-nothing local install proof only: release credibility may consume deterministic tmp/artifacts package-install proof records, but tmp/reports summaries cannot become release manifest source inputs
